name: Question 1
problem:
Consider the differential equation 

$$
\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}=\operatorname{cos}⁡(2x-5y-7).
$$

Using a substitution of the form $z=2x-5y,$ transform the differential equation into an equation of the form ${z}^{′}(x)=f(z).$ What is the function $f(z)?$

Question 1
?

Consider the differential equation dydx=cos⁡(2x−5y−7). Using a substitution of the form z=2x−5y, transform the differential equation into an equation of the form z′(x)=f(z). What is the function f(z)?

a
5cos⁡(z−7)+2
b
2−5cos⁡(z−7)
c
2−7cos⁡(z−5)
d
7−5cos⁡(z−2)
e
2cos⁡(z−7)−5
